messages:
maya: Quick Q — where's the best place to pull 503s for `acme-gen` in EU (gen route)? Need logs + dashboard link and a saved filter we can share with support.
rohit: Try the ingest HTTP view in LogSearch. Quick query I use:
```text
source:ingest.http AND json.model.name:\"acme-gen\" AND json.route:\"/gen\" AND http.status:503 AND region:\"eu-west-1\"
```
rohit: If you want to exclude health checks add `AND NOT json.route:\"/hc\"` so noise is lower.
infra-bot: Bookmark found — ops view: https://logs.redwood.ai/views/ops-eu-acme-503 (id: view_0x9a3)
infra-bot: Note: view filters include `org:acme`, model `acme-gen`, region `eu-west-1`, and excludes `/hc` in the current bookmark.
maya: perfect, thanks. Can someone add a saved search name we can reference in runbooks? (and a dashboard link)
taylor: Suggest name `ops/eu-acme-503-no-hc` for the saved query and add dashboard panel: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/ops/acme-eu-errors?panel=3 — it's already got the 503 timeseries and example traces.
jess: Also, can we tune the alert? the 503 pager fires a lot during deploys.
rohit: Two quick options: (1) bump threshold to 5% of requests over 5m, or (2) keep current rate but mute during deploy windows. I prefer option (1) for now.
samir: I can update the monitor. Plan: set threshold to 5% over 5m and add route exclusion for `/hc`. Ping me if we expect a deploy today so I can temporarily silence.
rohit: If you want to create the saved search via API:
```bash
curl -X POST https://logs.redwood.ai/api/v1/views \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $LOGS_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"ops/eu-acme-503-no-hc","query":"source:ingest.http AND json.model.name:\\"acme-gen\\" AND json.route:\\"/gen\\" AND http.status:503 AND region:\\"eu-west-1\\" AND NOT json.route:\\"/hc\\"","tags":["ops","acme","eu"]}'
```
maya: saved, linking to runbook now. thanks everyone :pray:
jess: thanks — monitoring PR incoming from @samir to update alert thresholds :thumbsup:
samir: will do. tagging incident on-call if it flaps after the change.
